long_biography.plain_text:
At HDV, founder Didier Vicens built separate homebuilding brands for distinct customer needs instead of forcing them into one offer. He paired the builders with a land-sourcing arm and expanded the regional footprint through acquired companies.

Vicens brought Arkéa Capital and IRDI Soridec Gestion into the group as minority investors to finance organic growth and acquisitions. Hexaom later bought control, while Vicens and three managers kept a minority stake and their operating posts. As president, he has stayed close to the branch network through visits with local teams across western France.
